title: The Morning Run
brief: Babe, you overslept AGAIN. Dan from the ATF wants you to meet him at El Cregs first. Then grab breakfast at Wawa and get to school before the bell!

stages.text: Meet ATF Agent Dan at El Cregs
stages.hint: Park it and walk up to Dan.

dialogue.line: Ciucci! Right on time. Well, almost.
Traffic on Pike. What've you got for me?
Nothing official. I just needed you to try these flautas. Best in Gwinnett.
You called me out here for flautas?
Interagency cooperation, Deputy. Now go, you're gonna be late.

stages.done: Got a bag of flautas from El Cregs. Dan says hi.
Two breakfast sandwiches and a Root Beer Ghost. Breakfast of champions.

title: Ghost Hunt
brief: Deputy! The Ghost delivery truck hit a pothole and cans went everywhere. Round up 8 before they get warm!

title: Speed Trap
brief: Some joker in a yellow coupe is doing 60 around the square. Ram him three times and he'll give up. Don't lose him.

title: Pep Rally
brief: Big game tonight, Ciucci! Get the town hyped. Knock over 15 things in 60 seconds. The principal did not hear this.

title: Honey-Do List
brief: Since you're out anyway: my Wawa coffee, then flowers from the square, then come home. Love you!
